scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader mending a net, who will row them out for two silver but never at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, with warm water.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black water and floating hymn-book pages in the mine. A page is marked "M. Brand" in pencil, and Teo recognises his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess Maren the harbor-master is in the cult. Oren takes 2 damage (down to 11).

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is much louder, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing. The party flees.

scenes.title: Stew and a plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide the next day with Sela rowing, and Dana will buy rope and a second lantern. Bram the innkeeper says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest and is back to full.
